name: Popular Engineering Skills Pack
description: A high-signal set of commonly useful engineering skills for agentic coding workflows, selected from public lifecycle skills with broad applicability.
useCases: Give a coding agent a full engineering lifecycle: spec, plan, implement incrementally, test, review, and ship.
Standardize how an agent approaches debugging, security, performance, and git workflow across projects.
examplePrompts: Use the spec-driven and planning skills to turn this feature idea into an ordered implementation plan.
Implement this change test-first, then run a code-review pass before committing.
